record.field: Brazilian fiscal board for electronic documents: drafts and pending transmission, authorized outbound and inbound totals, authorization rate, amount trends, e-doc state and operation analytics, and a recent documents list. Amounts are split by fiscal operation type so inbound and outbound documents are never summed together. Requires Brazilian Fiscal.
